title: מפתח/ת Full Stack – .NET & Angular
description:
**תיאור ודרישות משרה**
----------------------


אלעד מערכות מגייסת מפתח/ת Full Stack – .NET \& Angular
  

  

מחפש/ת תפקיד Full Stack עם מערכות מורכבות, אינטגרציות ועשייה טכנולוגית בסביבה מבצעית? זו הזדמנות להשתלב בצוות פיתוח האחראי על מערכות מידע קריטיות, לקחת חלק בפיתוח מקצה לקצה ולהשפיע על מערכות הנמצאות בשימוש שוטף של משתמשים רבים.
  

  

מה תעשו בתפקיד?  

  

  

  

פיתוח ותחזוקת מערכות Web מבצעיות בסביבת Angular ו\-.NET.
  

פיתוח Backend באמצעות C\#, .NET Framework ו\-.NET Core.
  

עבודה עם SQL Server, כולל כתיבת Stored Procedures, פונקציות ו\-Jobs.
  

פיתוח Web Services ו\-REST APIs ואינטגרציה עם מערכות חיצוניות.
  

השתתפות בתכנון, פיתוח, הטמעה ותחזוקה של מערכות לאורך מחזור החיים המלא.
  

עבודה בצוות ובסביבה טכנולוגית מורכבת עם ריבוי משתמשים.
  

לאחר תקופת הכשרה וחפיפה – ייתכנו כוננויות ומתן מענה לתקלות במערכות מבצעיות מעבר לשעות העבודה, לרבות בסופי שבוע ובחגים בהתאם לצורך.  

  

  

  

מה אנחנו מחפשים?  

  

  

  

לפחות שנתיים ניסיון בפיתוח מערכות .NET ו\-Web.
  

לפחות שנתיים ניסיון עם Angular 16 ומעלה.
  

לפחות שנתיים ניסיון בפיתוח C\# / .NET Framework / .NET Core.
  

לפחות שנתיים ניסיון בעבודה עם SQL Server.
  

לפחות שנה ניסיון בפיתוח Web Services ו\-REST API.
  

ניסיון באפיון והטמעת עקרונות ארכיטקטורה במערכות מרובות משתמשים.
  

עברית ברמת שפת אם ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה בקריאה ובכתיבה.
  

יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות, ראייה מערכתית, יכולת למידה ותודעת שירות גבוהה.  

  

  

  

יתרון משמעותי
  

  

ניסיון עם WinForms, JavaScript, Azure DevOps, Swagger, עבודה בסביבות עם דרישות אבטחה מחמירות, רקע בניתוח מערכות וניסיון בליווי מערכות משלב התכנון ועד לייצור ותמיכה במשתמשים.
  

  

השכלה
  

  

תואר אקדמי או הנדסאי/ת בתחום מדעי המחשב, או ניסיון מקצועי רלוונטי בהתאם לדרישות התפקיד.
  

  

משרה מלאה בקריית שדה התעופה במודל היברידי
  

  

אם את/ה Full Stack Developer שאוהב/ת מערכות מורכבות, עבודה End\-to\-End וסביבה שבה לקוד יש השפעה אמיתית בשטח – נשמח להכיר.
  

שלח/י קורות חיים
* הפניה מיועדת לנשים וגברים כאחד

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
At Digital Turbine, we make mobile advertising experiences more meaningful and rewarding for users, app publishers, and advertisers — intelligently connecting people in more ways, across more devices. We provide app publishers and advertisers with powerful ads and experiences that captivate consumers, fuel performance, and help telecoms and OEMs supercharge awareness, acquisition, and monetization. In a rapidly evolving industry, we are constantly innovating and creating better paths of discovery to connect consumers, publishers, and advertisers across the mobile ecosystem.


***Please note that Digital Turbine is a hybrid work environment\-only candidates local to the posting location will be considered.***

**We’re always on the lookout for great engineering talent!**
-------------------------------------------------------------

**We want to learn about your passion and skills, and find the best match for you.** **Join our talent community by applying here, and let’s stay connected for active and future roles.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The Role**
------------

Digital Turbine runs on small, autonomous pods that own an outcome and a roadmap end to end. We hire engineers, not language specialists: we care that you can reason about systems, pick the right tool for the problem, and ship reliable software across the stack.


As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surfaces that bring our marketplace together — campaign management and creation, unified dashboards and reporting, audience and asset tooling, and the APIs that connect demand to supply. You'll work across front\-end, back\-end, and data, contributing to the unified product architecture at the heart of our FY27 roadmap. The underlying platform requires heavy back\-end engineering, low\-latency optimization, and algorithmic problem\-solving to manage massive throughput and real\-time marketplace dynamics.


**About the Senior Full Stack Engineer Role**
---------------------------------------------


* Design and build full\-stack features — from responsive web front\-ends to back\-end services and APIs — that power campaign management, reporting, and marketplace optimization
* Choose the right language and tools for each problem (we run a polyglot stack), and keep the front end lightweight by pushing complex computational logic, data modeling, and heavy algorithmic weight into robust, scalable back\-end services
* Build and consume well\-designed APIs that integrate DT products into a unified architecture rather than isolated silos
* Own your services in production: testing, observability, performance, and on\-call, treating quality as a whole\-team responsibility
* Collaborate directly with product leads and stakeholders, contributing to scoping, estimation, and technical decisions within your pod
* Mentor teammates and raise engineering standards through code review, automation, and pragmatic architecture

**About You as the Senior Full Stack**
--------------------------------------

* 8\+ years building and shipping production platforms, with a heavy skew toward backend architecture, system design, and code optimization
* Strong algorithmic fundamentals, data structures, and a proven track record of solving complex data\-processing or resource optimization problems
* Demonstrated ability to be effective in more than one language/ecosystem (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Go, Scala, or C\+\+) — you optimize for the problem, not a single tool
* Solid command of modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React) and back\-end service design, plus relational and/or distributed data stores (MySQL, PostgreSQL, and similar)
* Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, testing, and system design
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, agile, ownership\-driven environment with limited hand\-holding

**Nice to have**
----------------

* **Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), containers, and CI/CD**
* **Exposure to AdTech, dashboards/BI surfaces, or high\-throughput data\-driven products**
* **Experience integrating ML or data services into product workflows**

About Digital Turbine:


Digital Turbine (NASDAQ: APPS) powers superior mobile consumer experiences and results for the world’s leading telcos, advertisers and publishers. Our end\-to\-end platform uniquely simplifies the ability to supercharge awareness, acquisition and monetization — connecting our partners to more consumers, in more ways, across more devices.


The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with global offices in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, Berlin, Singapore, Tel Aviv, and other cities around the world, serving top agency, app developer, and advertising markets.


We are honored to have achieved numerous awards as an employer of choice, around the world, including: BuiltIn's Best Places to Work Awards in 2022, 2023 and 2024, DUNS 100 Best Places to Work in Tech for 2023 and 2024, and BDICode's 100 Best Companies to Work in 2024\.


Digital Turbine is an equal opportunity employer committed to exemplifying diversity and inclusion around the world. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We embed diversity in our mindset, products, and teams to empower an inclusive, equitable, and culturally fluent environment. Building and continuously fostering this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators, partners, and innovators.


Digital Turbine will process the information you provide during the application process in accordance with the Digital Turbine Global Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Insights
description:
WalkMe is looking for a Senior Full\-Stack Developer to join our analytics department.
Our analytics solution provides dashboards and contextual insights for both our customers and internal departments at WalkMe.
As a developer here at WalkMe you will be a part of the outstanding analytics group which builds a Real\-Time Analytics Platform for WalkMe’s customers. We are looking for people who look at the world differently, people who are passionate about making sense out of huge amounts of data, who explore, analyze and lead the solutions they envision. * Investigate, implement and share new technologies and ideas.

### **What should you bring to the table?**

* B.Sc. in CS/EE from a leading university \- a must.
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with JavaScript and web technologies.
* 3\+ years of experience of server\-side development with Node.js.
* 3\+ years of experience of Client\-side development with React.
* Experience in designing and developing large distributed systems and microservices architecture.
* Experience working with NoSQL and Relational DBs.
* Experience working with large scale applications.
* Experience working with AWS or DevOps.

### **What we’d LOVE for you to bring to the table**

description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Full Stack Developer**
========================


Tel Aviv, Israel; Israel
**Job category:** Cloud **Job ID:** 135958\-en\_US **Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join our Data team at NetApp, where we build agentic products on top of the data platform and services that power them.In this role you will:Take a leading role in the design and development of agentic, customer\-facing products for the largest enterprise customers in the world.Design and own the DataOps and analytics platform that powers both our products and business\-critical insights: pipelines, services, and data models.Independently lead work end\-to\-end through the full development cycle: research, design, coding, testing, deployment, and production ownership.Work closely with stakeholders across the group: product, engineering, and business leaders.Our tech stack is diverse: we mainly code in TypeScript (Node.js and React), Python, and SQL, running services on Kubernetes. We use Snowflake, ELK, and vector databases, with Airflow and Superset for data pipelines and BI. We are heavy users of cloud technologies (mainly AWS), including Bedrock LLMs and Knowledge Bases.We use LLM\-based coding assistants such as Cursor and Claude Code in our day\-to\-day work, and we expect you to use them well.


**Job Requirements**
--------------------


* + 5\+ years of hands\-on coding and software design experience.
	+ Significant work experience with TypeScript and/or Python.
	+ BSc / MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
	+ Strong knowledge of the design and architecture of large\-scale cloud services, and experience taking them to production (AWS / Azure / GCP).
	+ Experience building and shipping LLM\-based features that real users depend on.
	+ Ability to work collaboratively within a team to meet aggressive goals and high\-quality standards, a strong aptitude for learning new technologies
	+ Strong oral and written communication skills, and fluent English.### **Advantages**


	+ Experience with SQL and with relational, analytical, or NoSQL databases.
	+ Experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and with Linux.
	+ Data engineering at scale: Airflow, Snowflake modeling, streaming, or scanning and processing very large data volumes.
	+ Experience with React.
	+ Performance and scale testing.
At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**


NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.


**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.


If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

title: Software and System Architect
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a passionate and talented SW \& System Architect to join our SW Architecture group. The position includes researching new technologies with focus on architecture definition of groundbreaking technologies in different domains \- networking, security, virtualization and orchestration. NVIDIA Architecture group consists of world\-class architects responsible for designing the next generation state\-of\-the\-art architecture for our DPUs \& NICs technologies.


You will play a key role defining the future of cloud solution stack, from HW to Application level, including orchestration, provisioning, network programmability and SDN. You will be working with various teams around the world including SW architects, R\&D, product, solution architects and external customers. This position offers a unique and exceptional opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology\-focused company shaping the future of data\-centers technologies.

**What you will be doing:**

* Lead architecture for cloud\-networking including orchestration, provisioning and security solutions
* Design state\-of\-the\-art system architecture for DPUs \& NICs technologies
* Build end\-to\-end solutions from application level to HW
* Responsible for writing effective, clear and reliable architecture specification
* Evaluate new technologies and innovate \& rapidly develop POC prototypes that can then be developed into full\-fledged products/solutions
* Work closely with different NVIDIA teams around the world including sw \& hw architects, R\&D, product, solution architects, application and field engineers and more
* Work with high profile customers on advanced and future technologies and solutions

**What we need to see:**

* B.Sc/M.Sc/Phd degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* 2\+ years of experience as SW Architect/System Architect
* 2\+ years of experience as SW developer
* Deep knowledge and experience with C, Python
* Hands on Linux development, Docker and Containers based technologies
* Experience with cloud and Data Center networking
* Wide knowledge and understanding of networking protocols and common network topologies
* Strong design, coding, analytical, debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work concurrently with multiple groups locally and abroad in the organization
* Excellent communication, documentation and presentation skills

**Ways to stand out from a crowd:**
